source_doc.title: Tower Semiconductor 6-K — OpenLight PDK available in Cadence EDA tools for PH18DA InP-on-silicon platform——Tower→PH18DA substitutability 判斷 addendum（[271]）

sources.quote: today announced the availability of OpenLight’s photonic Process Design Kit (PDK) for Tower Semiconductor’s PH18DA indium phosphide (InP)-on-silicon photonics platform in Cadence’s electronic design automation (EDA) tools.

Designs created using OpenLight‘s PDK support fabrication on Tower’s PH18DA InP-on-silicon photonics platform, which enables the integration of active photonic components - including lasers, modulators, and amplifiers - into a single monolithic PIC.

claims.statement: Tower→PH18DA substitutability 判斷（[271] packet，研究判斷非量測）：sub=4。理由：以 OpenLight PDK＋Cadence 流程在 PH18DA 上完成設計的 PIC 是製程鎖定的——換代工廠＝重設計＋重驗證（異質 III-V on silicon 平台無 drop-in 替代）；不評 5 因設計鎖定前存在平台級替代（UMC 已授權 imec iSiPP300 risk production 2026-27、GF 有矽光平台），競爭在 design-win 階段而非量產階段。
claims.disproof_condition: 若 UMC/GF 平台展示同級雷射整合（InP-on-Si active integration）且有客戶跨平台移植成功案例，sub 降至 3。
